## DNPC
### 0.1.5 Change Log
> For Create Fly 6.0.9-1 on Fabric 26.3, use Fabric Loader 0.19.5.
#### Global
##### Fixed
* Fixed Create parcels getting stuck after their receiving container was removed or replaced.
* Fixed pending Create supply orders blocking new orders to a different receiving inventory.
* Fixed NPC-to-NPC Create parcel delivery in loaded areas when unloaded day-cycle execution is enabled.
* Fixed completed Create train management requests blocking later requests for the same NPC.
##### Changed
* Changed NPC naming to use editable global pools and direct name selection in the NPC editor.
##### Improved
* Improved NPC tick performance when there is no Create train exit to process.
* Improved NPC movement performance by skipping chunk checks while waiting for pathfinding capacity.
* Improved initial and repeated world saves in large towns by preparing and reusing NPC settings.
* Reduced crowd pathfinding delays, including travel to scheduled waiting and resting spots.
* Improved Create job editor messages when the installed Create version lacks the required logistics features.

0.1.5 Change Log

For Create Fly 6.0.9-1 on Fabric 26.3, use Fabric Loader 0.19.5.

Global

Fixed
  • Fixed Create parcels getting stuck after their receiving container was removed or replaced.
  • Fixed pending Create supply orders blocking new orders to a different receiving inventory.
  • Fixed NPC-to-NPC Create parcel delivery in loaded areas when unloaded day-cycle execution is enabled.
  • Fixed completed Create train management requests blocking later requests for the same NPC.
Changed
  • Changed NPC naming to use editable global pools and direct name selection in the NPC editor.
Improved
  • Improved NPC tick performance when there is no Create train exit to process.
  • Improved NPC movement performance by skipping chunk checks while waiting for pathfinding capacity.
  • Improved initial and repeated world saves in large towns by preparing and reusing NPC settings.
  • Reduced crowd pathfinding delays, including travel to scheduled waiting and resting spots.
  • Improved Create job editor messages when the installed Create version lacks the required logistics features.
